name: io.github.ivandemurard/paris-compass-mcp
description: Address-level context on Paris commercial premises, from open data: what traded on a shopfront before, how the street turns over, what each source says and how sure it is. Anonymous read-only, no key to obtain.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The server carries the public Compass project, so nothing is required to run it. Set this only to read a different Supabase project — a derived deployment.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional, and never a service key. The anonymous publishable key, read-only under row level security — the same trust boundary a visitor of the website has.
